title: A Treatise on Dense Frost
summary: A treatise on packing frost so tightly that it strikes with the weight of stone and holds a stance against heavy blows.

title: The Canon of Rising Spikes
summary: A canon of ice called up from the ground in spikes and rows and rings that rake groups and hold them where they stand.

title: The Field Frost Compendium
summary: A compendium on spreading cold qi round the body as a living field that senses and guards and chills whatever enters it.

title: The Twin Frost Treatise
summary: A treatise on cold held in both hands as a matched pair so that one blow opens the guard and the second lands.

title: The Hawk and Rime Compendium
summary: A compendium of frost that rides cold air upward and stoops from above like a hawk and spreads in pale wings.

title: The Manual of Two-Track Cold
summary: A manual on running cold along two tracks of the body at once so that strike and guard are carried in the same breath.

title: The Wind-Sworn Frost Reckoning
summary: A reckoning of frost that a wind-sworn student carries on the breath and reads by the bend of a bitter gust.

title: The Oath of the Still Frost
summary: A sworn manual of frost held from a fixed stance that does not give way and releases all at once at the end.

title: The Manual of Open Frost Bearing
summary: A manual of frost thrown in plain sight along a clear bearing that offers no cover to those it meets.
